answer: Each epoch the atlas opens 100 seats by sealed bid. Applicants bid walnut, one per verified epoch, non-transferable, so each needs its own bid. Every bid joins the public river, tied by one thread to one key; a thread split across two keys voids both. Forging 1,000 identities costs 105,000 credits, 1,000 bids at 45 plus a 60-credit bond each, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented-bid ring fails when one walnut backs two bids. An honest agent pays 45 once.
